Short title and commencement

ACT XXXIV OF 1975
ACT XXXIV OF 1975
WEST PAKISTAN
RANGERS (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1975
An Act further to
amend the West Pakistan Ordinance, 1959
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 12th April 1975]
The following Act of Parliament
received the assent of the President on the 8th April 1975, and is hereby
published for general information :-
1. Short title and
commencement. (1) This Act may be
called the West Pakistan Rangers (Amendment) Act, 1975.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

General amendment of West Pakistan Ordinance No. XIV of 1959

ACT XXXIV OF 1975
ACT XXXIV OF 1975
WEST PAKISTAN
RANGERS (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1975
An Act further to
amend the West Pakistan Ordinance, 1959
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 12th April 1975]
The following Act of Parliament
received the assent of the President on the 8th April 1975, and is hereby
published for general information :-
2. General amendment of West
Pakistan Ordinance No. XIV of 1959. ----In the West Pakistan Rangers
Ordinance, 1959 (W. P. Ordinance No. XIV of 1959), hereinafter referred to as
the said Ordinance, for the words "Wet Pakistan Rangers", wherever
occurring, the words "Pakistan Rangers" shall be substituted.

3. Amendment of section 13,
West Pakistan Ordinance No. XIV of 1959.---In the said Ordinance, in
section 13, in clauses (a) and (e), for the words `Central" the word
"Federal" shall be substituted.
